title: Consume the Take action in the Companion adapter

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0089 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale merge y a lo que sigue' — the adapter-side consumption of the Take action (AC-017 discovery and AC-018 request), completing the operator-facing Take from the Companion adapter's projection and request layers. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0089.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors, SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 / US-010 AC-017 / AC-018, and the 2026-08-25 user directive.

claims.statement: projectCompanionTakeActions(catalog) surfaces a Show-level Take action from the optional catalog.showActions sibling (filtering kind production.take) as a CompanionTakeActionDefinition; a catalog without the production:take scope yields no Take action. buildTakeCommandRequest(showId, execution) turns a Take intent into the exact device Take request — POST /api/device/shows/:showId/production/take with the Show id percent-encoded and a body of precisely { operationId, expectedPreviewRevision }. Both mirror the already-reviewed visibility projection and request builder, and Take rides only on showActions, never the visibility actions array.
claims.evidence: companion/src/take.ts; the visibility analogues companion/src/catalog.ts and companion/src/command.ts; server/src/routes/deviceControl.ts Take route as the contract source.

claims.statement: These are pure, total projections and request construction with no I/O, parsing, or branching beyond the showActions filter — the same shape as the visibility project and build that were adversarially reviewed. The contract test and the type-checker cover them without a separate review; a catalog-driven test asserts the Take action appears iff showActions is present and that the request matches the route and body exactly.

Additive to the @overlaykit/companion package; no server, protocol, or Studio change. This slice delivers the adapter Take projection and request only — dispatching the Take over the transport (a Take executor), registering the Take in the module and facade, durable/signed Take execution, and Scene/trigger actions remain deferred (frontier nodes adapter-take-consumption delivered; companion-catalog-take-trigger-actions holds the remainder).
claims.evidence: companion/src/take.ts (no transport dispatch); companion/src/index.ts exports; the deferred frontier nodes.

successCriteria.statement: The adapter surfaces a Take action from a catalog that carries showActions and none from one that does not.
successCriteria.verification: companion/tests/take.contract.test.ts asserts projectCompanionTakeActions over catalogs with and without the production:take scope.

successCriteria.statement: The adapter builds the exact device Take request, percent-encoding the Show id and carrying only operationId and expectedPreviewRevision.
successCriteria.verification: Tests assert the method, path, encoding, and the two body keys.

successCriteria.statement: No existing behavior regresses and the adapter stays dependency-isolated.
successCriteria.verification: npm run check and npm run build pass across all workspaces; companion depends only on @overlaykit/protocol.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0089 records the adapter Take projection and request and the deferred dispatch/module/durable residuals before implementation of the record.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

A contract test proves Take discovery and request construction; the full check passes.
